title: StateLoop: Persistent State for Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.35544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped Transformers offer a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling by repeatedly applying a shared backbone. Vanilla looped Transformers use each backbone output directly as the input to the next iteration. These outputs may contain information useful several iterations later, but retaining it across the loop depends entirely on the single hidden state. We introduce StateLoop, which maintains one additional persistent state per token to retain information across iterations. At each iteration, a learned gate controls how much of the previous state is retained and how much information from the backbone output is incorporated. The updated state is projected back and added to the backbone output for subsequent iterations and final prediction. This design reduces Pile perplexity and improves average accuracy across eight zero-shot tasks over Vanilla Looped. Its perplexity advantage over Vanilla Looped grows with trained loop depth,

translated_title: StateLoop：为循环Transformer设计的持久状态
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享的主干网络，为语言建模提供了一种参数高效的方法。原始循环Transformer直接将每个主干网络的输出作为下一次迭代的输入。这些输出中可能包含在若干次迭代之后才有用的信息，但要在整个循环过程中保留这些信息，完全依赖于单一的隐藏状态。我们提出了StateLoop，它为每个token维护一个额外的持久状态，以便在迭代之间保留信息。在每次迭代中，一个可学习的门控机制控制前一状态的保留程度，以及从主干网络输出中融入的信息量。更新后的状态被投影回来并加到主干网络输出上，用于后续迭代和最终预测。这种设计降低了Pile数据集上的困惑度，并在八个零样本任务上比原始循环Transformer取得了更高的平均准确率。其相对于原始循环Transformer的困惑度优势随着训练循环深度的增加而增长。
tldr: StateLoop通过为每个token引入一个由可学习门控控制的持久状态来在循环迭代之间保留信息，从而降低语言建模困惑度并提升零样本任务准确率。
en_tdlr: StateLoop maintains a per-token persistent state controlled by a learned gate to retain information across loop iterations, reducing perplexity and improving zero-shot task accuracy over vanilla looped Transformers.
